owner_approval: 2026-10-14, in chat: 'yes run A22, then A21, then A20'
why_this_exists: The owner's simplest form of the theme idea: 'if AI is booming, GPU production rises, then metal rises' -- a move in a raw material should reach the stocks exposed to it. If investors absorb commodity news slowly, last month's commodity move predicts next month's return of exposed stocks. Driesprong, Jacobsen & Maat (JFE 2008, abstract read 2026-10-14) report oil price changes predict lower stock market returns worldwide, which they attribute to investor underreaction. Steps 306 and 354 found linked information is priced within the month for stocks; this tests whether commodities are different.

data.futures: data/futures_roll_repaired_v1/weekly_returns_repaired.csv.gz, Friday-to-Friday returns 2005-01-07 to 2026-09-04, flagged roll weeks set to missing (Step 249). Proxy correlations in its manifest: CL 0.93, GC 0.98, SI 0.98, ZC 0.63 (corn is the weakest series).
data.stocks: daily panel as A19, resampled to Friday closes; liquidity and SIC as A19
data.market: ES=F weekly return (an excess-of-cash return by construction)

cadence: decisions every 4 weeks on the futures' Friday grid; signal = compounded return over the 4 weeks ending at the decision Friday; target = compounded return over the next 4 weeks. Non-overlapping.

T1_producer_groups.measure: for each group, equal-weight 4-week return of its liquid members minus the equal-weight liquid universe; pooled regression of next-period group excess return on the group's commodity return over the last period, one slope across all four groups
T1_producer_groups.significance: block bootstrap over decision dates (block 6, groups kept together), 4000 draws
T1_producer_groups.declared_sign: POSITIVE: a commodity rise is followed by its producers outperforming
T1_producer_groups.pass: design slope > 0 with p < 0.0167 AND at least 3 of 4 groups' own slopes positive in design AND holdout pooled slope > 0

T2_estimated_exposure_cross_section.exposure: for each liquid stock, the commodity beta from a 104-week regression of its weekly return on ES=F and ONE commodity (separately for each of CL, NG, HG, GC, SI, ZC, ZS, ZW), using only weeks up to the decision. Data-driven: no hand map.
T2_estimated_exposure_cross_section.score: sum over the 8 commodities of beta x the commodity's last-4-week return, residualised each decision on own 4-week return, own 12-1 momentum and the SIC2 4-week return (A19's controls)
T2_estimated_exposure_cross_section.universe: A19's: close >= $5, 63-day median dollar volume >= $5M, known SIC, 104 complete weekly returns
T2_estimated_exposure_cross_section.window: design 2013-2018 (first 104 weeks of 2011-2012 are estimation only), holdout 2019-2026
T2_estimated_exposure_cross_section.measurement: A19's screen: rank IC, ten-decile ladder via decile_shape (clears AND clears_calibrated at alpha 0.0167), block bootstrap block 6, leave-one-SIC2-out and leave-top-10-names-out
T2_estimated_exposure_cross_section.placebo: 200 draws in which the 8 commodities' last-4-week returns are replaced by their returns from a randomly chosen earlier 4-week period (exposures kept, timing destroyed); real design IC must exceed the placebo 95th percentile
T2_estimated_exposure_cross_section.pass: every criterion of the A19 screen, with bar 0.0167

T3_oil_predicts_market_replication.measure: regression of next-4-week ES=F return on last-4-week CL=F return
T3_oil_predicts_market_replication.significance: Newey-West t with 3 lags and block bootstrap (block 6), both reported; verdict on the bootstrap
T3_oil_predicts_market_replication.pass: design slope < 0 with p < 0.0167 AND holdout slope < 0. A market-timing signal on one series is a single bet; even a pass would be reported as a replication, not a strategy.

cumulative_search_note: These three sit on top of 354 steps; the futures panel was also used in Steps 248-249 (futures trend IC, closed).
book_only_if_a_cross_sectional_trial_pas: long-only, as A19's registry; T3 cannot produce a long-only stock book
known_weaknesses_declared_up_front: Front-month futures with rolls repaired by outlier removal, not true roll adjustment (P1 in the paid queue). Corn is weakest.
The SIC map is from general knowledge, written before any stock return was computed; group sizes are small for copper and grains.
Survivorship in the stock panel as A19.
Weekly Friday grid: Driesprong et al. found a lag of a few days strengthens the effect; a 4-week block with no skip is the plain version.
